title.zh: 查询系统内置布局列表
title.en: Query the List of Built-in System Layouts

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

The per-user QPS limit for this API is 10 calls per second. Exceeding this limit triggers rate limiting, which may affect your business. Call the API responsibly.
